card.name: Stock phrases in census, license, and label text
card.fires_on: Words inside stock phrases that the model has seen many times, mainly US census demographic summaries (age ranges, percentages, 'the county has'). It also fires in legal or license text and in label wording such as 'lowest effective dose for'.

modes.label: Census demographics
modes.description: Numbers and linking words inside Wikipedia-style census paragraphs on age groups, population and area.

modes.description: Linking words in fixed software license or legal sentences.

modes.description: The word 'for' in the fixed advice about using the lowest effective dose.

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing a memorized phrase, with code-like tokens promoted and line breaks or spaces suppressed.
card.plain: It lights up on words in well-worn stock phrases, like census summaries and license text, where the next words are very predictable.
